scheme_name: Fair Recreational Activity and Non-Competitive Involvement in Sports Urban Connect Scheme (F.R.A.N.C.I.S Urban Connect Scheme)
other_conditions: Applicant must own land of at least 2,000 square metres within the municipal jurisdiction

Eligible entities include local municipal bodies, schools, colleges or other institutions, registered sports clubs, registered housing societies, and other registered bodies promoting physical fitness and sport
Applicants whose land falls in peripheral Panchayat jurisdiction may also be considered eligible
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance to develop safe play areas and related sports facilities in urban communities.
